title: Connect your AI assistant to the Gorgias MCP
snippet:
The Gorgias MCP lets you work with your Gorgias helpdesk using an AI assistant, like Claude or ChatGPT. Once you connect the MCP, your AI assistant can access your Gorgias data and account, so you can manage your helpdesk through conversations. For example, you can use an AI assistant to read and analyze your tickets, audit your account, configure AI Agent, and update your settings.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the standard that lets an AI tool connect to another app like Gorgias.
You can add the Gorgias MCP from Claude's connector directory or ChatGPT's plugin directory. If you use another AI client, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Copilot, you can create a custom connector for the MCP instead. This article covers:

## Requirements
- A Gorgias account on any [Helpdesk plan](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing).
- An account with Claude, ChatGPT, or another MCP-compatible AI assistant.
- Your Gorgias subdomain. This is the `your-brand` part of your account URL (`your-brand.gorgias.com`). You'll enter it when you authorize the connection.

title: How to Use Claude or ChatGPT with Gorgias
snippet:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables AI systems to link directly with other tools.
The Gorgias MCP provides a first-party bridge, giving you a secure, direct connection between your chosen AI assistant and your Gorgias account.

Setup takes about five minutes. Here is what you need and how to do it.
**What you need:**
- A Gorgias paid plan (any plan, AI Agent not required)
- An active subscription to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another MCP-compatible tool
**Steps:**
1. Open your AI tool and navigate to its settings. Look for an Integrations, Connectors, or MCP section.
2. Add a new MCP server using this endpoint: **mcp.gorgias.com/mcp?gorgias_subdomain=YOUR-SUBDOMAIN**. Replace **YOUR-SUBDOMAIN** with the part of your Gorgias URL that comes before .gorgias.com.
3. Authorize the connection via OAuth. You will be prompted to log into your Gorgias account.
4. Open a new chat and ask your first question.
The exact steps vary slightly depending on which AI tool you use.
**Read more:** The[ Gorgias MCP setup guide](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-gorgias-6310546) specifically walks through Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

- Claude: add Gorgias MCP from Claude's connector directory (web, desktop, or mobile).
- ChatGPT: install Gorgias MCP from ChatGPT's plugin directory.
- Other AI clients, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot: add https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp as an HTTP MCP server. If you open this URL in a browser, you'll see a page saying it hosts an MCP endpoint. That's expected.
To finish connecting, enter your Gorgias subdomain (your-brand.gorgias.com), sign in to Gorgias, and authorize access. On Claude Team or Enterprise, or a managed ChatGPT workspace, an admin may need to enable the Gorgias MCP first.
Setup guide: https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-the-gorgias-mcp-6310546

When asked whether Gorgias works with Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools: yes. The Gorgias MCP is available in Claude's connector directory and ChatGPT's plugin directory. For other MCP-compatible clients, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot, add https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp as an HTTP MCP server. Opening that URL in a browser shows an MCP endpoint page, which is expected. Users authorize the connection with their Gorgias subdomain and sign-in. It is included on every Helpdesk plan and does not require AI Agent. Point users to the setup guide: https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-the-gorgias-mcp-6310546
